column2: Alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli llāhi ʾaḍalla ʾaʿmālahum
Walladhīna ʾāmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti waʾāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyitihim waʾaṣlaḥa bālahum
Dhālika biʾanna ladhīna kafarū tabaʿū l-bāṭila waʾanna ladhīna ʾāmanū tabaʿū l-ḥaqqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu llāhu lilnnāsi ʾamthālahum

Faʾidhā laqītumu ladhīna kafarū faḍarba r-riqābi ḥattā ʾidhā ʾathkhantumūhum fashuddū l-wathāqa faʾimmā mannan baʿdu waʾimmā fidāʾan ḥattā taḍaʿa l-ḥarbu ʾawzārahā dhālika walaw yashāʾu llāhu lantaṣara minhum walākin liyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin walladhīna qutilū fi sabīli llāhi falan yuḍilla ʾaʿmālahum
Sayahdīhim wayuṣliḥu bālahum
Wayudkhiluhumu l-jannata ʿarrafahā lahum
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū ʾin tanṣurū llāha yanṣurkum wayuthabbit ʾaqdāmakum
Walladhīna kafarū fataʿsan lahum waʾaḍalla ʾaʿmālahum
Dhālika biʾannahum karihū mā ʾanzala llāhu faʾaḥbaṭa ʾaʿmālahum
ʾafalam yasīrū fi l-ʾarḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu ladhīna min qablihim dammara llāhu ʿalayhim walilkāfirīna ʾamthāluhā
Dhālika biʾanna llāha mawlā ladhīna ʾāmanū waʾanna l-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahum
ʾinna llāha yudkhilu ladhīna ʾāmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajri min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru walladhīna kafarū yatamattaʿūna wayaʾkulūna kamā taʾkulu l-ʾanʿāmu walnnāru mathwan lahum
Wakaʾayyin min qaryatin hiya ʾashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika lati ʾakhrajatka ʾahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahum
ʾafaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūʾu ʿamalihi wattabaʿū ʾahwāʾahum

Mathalu l-jannati lati wuʿida l-muttaqūna fīhā ʾanhārun min māʾin ghayri ʾāsinin waʾanhārun min labanin lam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu waʾanhārun min khamrin ladhdhatin lilshshāribīna waʾanhārun min ʿasalin muṣaffan walahum fīhā min kulli th-thamarāti wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khālidun fi n-nāri wasuqū māʾan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa ʾamʿāʾahum
Waminhum man yastamiʿu ʾilayka ḥattā ʾidhā kharajū min ʿindika qālū lilladhīna ʾūtū l-ʿilma mādhā qāla ʾānifan ʾūlāʾika ladhīna ṭabaʿa llāhu ʿalā qulūbihim wattabaʿū ʾahwāʾahum
Walladhīna htadaw zādahum hudan waʾātāhum taqwāhum
Fahal yanẓurūna ʾillā s-sāʿata ʾan taʾtiyahum baghtatan faqad jāʾa ʾashrāṭuhā faʾannā lahum ʾidhā jāʾathum dhikrāhum
Faʿlam ʾannahu lā ʾilāha ʾillā llāhu wastaghfir lidhanbika walilmuʾminīna walmuʾmināti walllahu yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwākum

Wayaqūlu ladhīna ʾāmanū lawlā nuzzilat sūratun faʾidhā ʾunzilat sūratun muḥkamatun wadhukira fīhā l-qitālu raʾayta ladhīna fi qulūbihim maraḍun yanẓurūna ʾilayka naẓara l-maghshiyyi ʿalayhi mina l-mawti faʾawlā lahum
Ṭāʿatun waqawlun maʿrūfun faʾidhā ʿazama l-ʾamru falaw ṣadaqū llāha lakāna khayran lahum
Fahal ʿasaytum ʾin tawallaytum ʾan tufsidū fi l-ʾarḍi watuqaṭṭiʿū ʾarḥāmakum
ʾūlāʾika ladhīna laʿanahumu llāhu faʾaṣammahum waʾaʿmā ʾabṣārahum
ʾafalā yatadabbarūna l-qurʾāna ʾam ʿalā qulūbin ʾaqfāluhā
ʾinna ladhīna rtaddū ʿalā ʾadbārihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā sh-shayṭānu sawwala lahum waʾamlā lahum
Dhālika biʾannahum qālū lilladhīna karihū mā nazzala llāhu sanuṭīʿukum fi baʿḍi l-ʾamri walllahu yaʿlamu ʾisrārahum
Fakayfa ʾidhā tawaffathumu l-malāʾikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum waʾadbārahum
Dhālika biʾannahumu tabaʿū mā ʾaskhaṭa llāha wakarihū riḍwānahu faʾaḥbaṭa ʾaʿmālahum
ʾam ḥasiba ladhīna fi qulūbihim maraḍun ʾan lan yukhrija llāhu ʾaḍghānahum
Walaw nashāʾu laʾaraynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum walataʿrifannahum fi laḥni l-qawli walllahu yaʿlamu ʾaʿmālakum
Walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum walṣṣābirīna wanabluwā ʾakhbārakum
ʾinna ladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli llāhi washāqqū r-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā lan yaḍurrū llāha shayan wasayuḥbiṭu ʾaʿmālahum
Yāʾayyuhā ladhīna ʾāmanū ʾaṭīʿū llāha waʾaṭīʿū r-rasūla walā tubṭilū ʾaʿmālakum
ʾinna ladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli llāhi thumma mātū wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira llāhu lahum
Falā tahinū watadʿū ʾilā s-salmi waʾantumu l-ʾaʿlawna walllahu maʿakum walan yatirakum ʾaʿmālakum
ʾinnamā l-ḥayawātu d-dunyā laʿibun walahwun waʾin tuʾminū watattaqū yuʾtikum ʾujūrakum walā yasalkum ʾamwālakum
ʾin yasalkumūhā fayuḥfikum tabkhalū wayukhrij ʾaḍghānakum

Hāʾantum hāʾulāʾi tudʿawna litunfiqū fi sabīli llāhi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal faʾinnamā yabkhalu ʿan nafsihi walllahu l-ghaniyyu waʾantumu l-fuqarāʾu waʾin tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnū ʾamthālakum
